create_CLILoader: create a CLILoader instance to load images from a file or folder with page range and output directory options
run_CLILoader_load: run CLILoader.load to load images from a file or folder with optional high-resolution support
build_CLILoader_common_options: build a Click command decorator with common options: input_path, output_dir, page_range, images, and debug flags
test_CLILoader_parse_range_str: test CLILoader.parse_range_str to parse comma-separated page ranges like '0,5-10,20' into a sorted deduplicated list of integers
review_CLILoader: review the CLILoader class that loads images from files or folders and prepares them for Surya document processing
